prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied approved illustration into ONE finished portrait 1024x1536 children's coloring page for a four-year-old using thick crayons. Keep the recognizable hedgehog characters, their sizes, emotions, and main action, while simplifying the composition for a tall page with generous white margins. BLACK clean bold smooth outlines only on a PURE WHITE page; all fur, faces, bodies, objects and background interiors remain WHITE for coloring. Use very large closed fillable shapes. Hedgehog quills become a simple scalloped/spiky outer silhouette and only a few large internal clusters; no individual hairs, stippling or tiny quill marks. No gray, shading, gradients, hatching, shadows, colored pixels, pencil texture, decorative border, logo or lettering. No solid black areas except tiny eye pupils and tiny nose centers. Remove ALL source words and numbers. Simplify environment to 2 or 3 iconic outlined props and leave broad open white areas. Maintain distinct complete bodies and natural paws; never fuse a baby into an adult. Scene: bedtime tooth brushing. Keep exactly three hedgehogs: tall Mama at center helps the tiny baby PomPom at her right brush his teeth with one little toothbrush; larger child PinPin at left holds his own toothbrush against his mouth. Both children wear simple plain towels over their shoulders. Mama's free paw rests visibly on the baby's upper back; do not merge baby and mother and do not add hands. All feet and bodies stay distinct. Reframe these three close together for portrait, full body, with only the edge of a simple washbasin at left and a plain towel on one wall hook. Remove the complex room, wooden textures, decorative pottery and tub background. Large easy coloring shapes and very few quill marks.
visualReview: Passed: bold black outlines, white fill areas, no lettering, readable distinct bodies and faithful action.
